name: Pumpkin

schedule.notes: Calculate backwards from Halloween or first frost — needs 85 to 120 days.
Skin is hard and resists thumbnail; stem dry and corky. Cut with 4 in of stem.

harvest.cues: Deep uniform color, hard rind, dry corky stem. Skin should resist thumbnail pressure.
harvest.storageNotes: Cure 10 days at 80 F dry. Store at 50 to 55 F. Pie pumpkins keep 3 to 6 months; Cinderella types up to a year.

varieties.name: Small Sugar (New England Pie)
varieties.notes: 6 to 8 lb. Dense flesh, low water. The pie standard.

varieties.name: Jack O' Lantern
varieties.notes: 10 to 15 lb. Watery flesh; great for carving, mediocre for eating.

varieties.name: Cinderella (Rouge Vif d'Etampes)
varieties.notes: Flat, deeply ribbed red-orange. Excellent eating and exceptional storage.

notes: Needs 50+ square feet per vine. Plant on a compost mound for free fertility. Wood mulch under fruit prevents rot from ground contact.
